seeds.title: evaluate can hang on a nested-quantifier regex
seeds.detail: (a+)+$ on 40 'a' plus 'b' did not finish in 8 s. Plan Risks accepts this and the spec states no limit. Hand to verify-limits.

seeds.title: evaluate raises on non-string pattern, sample or non-dict rule
seeds.detail: TypeError for non-string input, AttributeError for a non-dict rule. S-013 and S-014 callers must pass strings from read_rules and must wrap evaluate if forge data can be malformed.
